description: List the deploy-like changes nami saw in the resource attributes services send, newest first, in the window (since, default the last hour): a new commit (vcs.ref.head.revision), a new service.version, a new deployment.environment.name, or a changed cicd.* attribute. Use it to ask whether something changed shortly before errors or latency began. It reads only what the services reported; it does not ask a deployment system. from is absent when this is the first value nami saw for that service, which is not necessarily a deploy.

service.description: Only telemetry from the service with exactly this service.name (case-sensitive). sources_status lists the names; an unknown name is refused with the known ones.

since.description: Start of the window: a negative duration relative to now (-30s, -15m, -2h, -7d) or a past RFC 3339 time (2026-11-22T13:00:00Z). The window ends now (when the snapshot was taken). Default -60m. traces_get reads a trace whole whatever since says.

fields.description: Return only these members of each result row (of the trace for traces_get). Default: all members. Unknown fields are refused with the allowed field names.

max_bytes.description: Size budget for one page, in UTF-8 bytes of JSON, 1024 to 262144, default 32768. Rows that do not fit move to the next page (see next_cursor). Raise it only when a single row or span does not fit.

snapshot_id.description: ID of the frozen view of the data an earlier answer returned. Pass it to get byte-identical answers across tools in one investigation. Expires 30 minutes after it was taken; then call without it. With cursor, snapshot_id is optional: the cursor carries its snapshot.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the preceding page; keep all other arguments unchanged.
